description: wsc setup reports a running watcher as FAIL: tools/verbs/setup.py check_watcher (line 202) runs the pre-J12 path harness/core/job.sh, which J12 moved to core/harness/job.sh, so bash exits 127 (seen 2026-11-02 22:40 UTC with the watcher up, heartbeat current). Point it at core/harness/job.sh (through core/proxy/tools/layout.py or the same helper the other checks use, not a second hard-coded path), add a host test that fails on a path that does not exist, and grep tools/ and harness/napoleon for other pre-J12 harness/core paths.
title: wsc setup: the watcher check runs the pre-J12 job.sh path
